verdict.rationale: The evidence shows chats can keep working while you start another (figma-make-docs-1), and that workflows can be packaged as reusable instructions (figma-make-docs-15). Both are user-initiated, one-off agent runs or prompt templates. Nothing documents recurring schedules, event triggers, or automations that run on their own in the background, so there is no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
